cmd: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test:unit

testChange.reason: Three pre-existing tests encoded the pre-fold layout and were updated to the moved contract, none weakened: WorktreeView.test.ts mount() now passes getInitialIdleSeeded so tests about OTHER contracts see the tail already presented (and therefore open) rather than each fighting a fold they are not about; WorktreeController.test.ts counted rendered rows for "renders the pushed tree" and now counts drawn rows PLUS the disclosure count, which is the reachability the spec actually requires; WorktreeController.state.test.ts asserted worktreeCollapsed was empty and now asserts that of worktree keys only, plus that the namespaced idle-tail key IS seeded — the namespace exists precisely so those two claims are separable.
